description:
Samii’s debut EP ‘Figuring It Out’ is an ode to self-discovery.
Samii draws inspiration from her own experiences of love, loss and personal growth across four beautifully crafted tracks.

Whether evoking dreamy, bittersweet nostalgia on low-slung opener ‘Spaced Out Summer Tours & Back Again’ or letting her voice soar on 
the majestic ‘Wake Me Up’, ‘Figuring It Out’ touches on the universal through astute observations of her own personal experiences.

Cutting across generic boundaries with ease, Samii deftly balances these moments of reflection and expression, to build a world that reveals itself with every track.

A consummate, poised debut, it’s clear Samii is well on her way.
credits:
all songs written & performed by Samii Hagos
production by dego,Mr Mensah,Kaidi Tatham & Matt Lord
